objectives.statement: Understand foundational mental models and architecture of C Programming
Implement secure, reproducible solutions across real-world C Programming tasks
Diagnose common production edge cases, bottlenecks, and vulnerabilities in C Programming
Architect scalable enterprise workflows aligned with C Programming industry best practices

prerequisites: Basic computer literacy and comfort navigating the terminal or command prompt
Understanding of file paths and simple text editing

modules.title: C Translation Architecture, Memory Model & Basic Types
modules.summary: Master the 4 stages of C compilation, memory segment layout (Text, Data, BSS, Heap, Stack), primitive types, and formatted IO.
lessonTitles: The C Compilation Pipeline & Process Memory Layout
Fixed-Width Types, Operators & Formatted Standard IO
modules.checkpoint: Compile C17 programs with zero warnings and diagram stack frame allocations.

modules.title: Pointers, Memory Allocation & Data Structures
modules.summary: Understand pointer indirection, pointer arithmetic, dynamic memory allocation (malloc, calloc, realloc, free), structs, and defensive buffer management.
modules.checkpoint: Build a leak-free dynamic resizing array with Valgrind passing with 0 errors.

modules.title: POSIX Systems Programming, File IO & Production Quality
modules.summary: Master low-level file descriptors, binary serialization, error handling with errno, multi-threaded POSIX pthreads, and automated test suites.
lessonTitles: File Descriptors, Binary IO & Defensive Error Handling
Multi-Threading with POSIX pthreads & Thread Safety
modules.checkpoint: Build a thread-safe multi-worker job queue with POSIX mutexes and condition variables.

practiceActivities: Compile programs with strict GCC flags: -std=c17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic
Inspect memory allocations, pointer arithmetic, and stack vs heap lifespans
Debug segfaults and buffer overflows using GDB and Valgrind memory analyzers
assessmentCheckpoints: C Translation Architecture, Memory Model & Basic Types Checkpoint (70% pass threshold)
Pointers, Memory Allocation & Data Structures Checkpoint (70% pass threshold)
POSIX Systems Programming, File IO & Production Quality Checkpoint (70% pass threshold)
projects: CLI Memory-Safe String Tokenizer & Dynamic Vector
POSIX Multi-Threaded HTTP File Server with Epoll / Select
proficiencyCriteria: Accurately predict variable lifetimes, alignment, and struct padding in C17
Manage dynamic memory safely without leaks or double-free vulnerabilities
Implement defensive bounds checking across all buffer operations

resources.title: ISO/IEC 9899 C Standard & cppreference C Guide
